title: Deni: Puntland 'Acting Independently' on Resources and International Agreements Until Consensus Government Formed
detail: Two days after his parallel-authority deadline passed without a formal declaration, President Said Abdullahi Deni said Puntland would manage its own resources and enter international agreements independently 'until a consensus-based government is reached,' while insisting Puntland has 'never abandoned the federal system.' The statement amounts to a functional, gray-zone assertion of independence in specific domains rather than a declared breakaway government — de-escalating the immediate crisis while keeping core disputes with Mogadishu unresolved.

media.caption: Garowe Online (Jun 16, 2026): Puntland 'acting independently' until consensus-based government is formed, says President Deni

title: Jubaland's Madobe: Federal Mandate Has Expired, Crisis 'Requires Dialogue'
detail: Jubaland President Ahmed Madobe said Somalia's crisis 'requires dialogue,' criticized the deployment of security forces against Mogadishu demonstrators as undemocratic, argued federal member states hold constitutional authority over their own governance and elections, and declared the federal administration's mandate had expired. The statement echoed Puntland's position and signaled continued alignment between the two federal member states within the opposition Somali Future Council.

media.caption: Garowe Online (Jun 16, 2026): Jubaland says Somalia's crisis requires dialogue, warns against politicizing army
